name: python-pipeline
description: Turbo shim for the Python document pipeline. The real project is pyproject.toml; these scripts exist so the app joins the task graph and can declare a build dependency on the wire contract.

scripts.build: uv sync --frozen && uv run python scripts/generate_models.py
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src tests scripts
scripts.format: uv run ruff format src tests scripts
